issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

datastores.description: Optional mapping of the datastore configurations

app.description: Optional Data Lake C3 App / Microservice where this domain is hosted

callAppInLocalJvm.description:
If true, operations on types in this domain will be executed in the consumer process
using callInLocalJvmApp instead of being remoted to the target app.
This is useful when the consumer needs to avoid network overhead while still executing in the target app's context

Note: this is not completely risk free as the metadata of the target app and the consumer app may be different and
the loading of the metadata may fail

@see Db.Domain#app
